Metadata.title: BlazWitcher | Fuzzy Pinyin Search for Chrome and Edge
Metadata.description: Search open tabs, bookmarks and browsing history in one shortcut. BlazWitcher matches Chinese pinyin, initials and English, and can organize tabs into groups with AI.
Metadata.imageAlt: BlazWitcher browser extension for Chrome and Microsoft Edge

slogan.line1: Pinyin search for Chrome and Edge

LandingPage.description: Find an open tab, a saved bookmark, or a page from your browsing history by typing Chinese, full Pinyin, Pinyin initials, or English. Blazwitcher also offers AI tab grouping in the browser extension.

compatibility.label: Supported browsers
compatibility.edge_install: Install in Edge from the Chrome Web Store. Allow extensions from other stores if prompted.

actions.install_store: Install from the Chrome Web Store

video.title: Blazwitcher: Pinyin search and AI tab grouping
video.description: Less searching, more focus. Meet Blazwitcher in 28 seconds.

1.title: Fuzzy Pinyin Search
1.description: Supports Chinese/English hybrid fuzzy search, sorted by weight and recent usage for faster targeting

2.title: AI Grouping
2.description: AI-powered tab grouping based on domain and title, with 16-second snapshot recovery

3.title: Global Second-level Search
3.description: Search all tabs, bookmarks and 14-day history, supports /t /b /h targeted search

4.title: Full Keyboard Operation
4.description: Shortcut key activation,/ commands to trigger, type /s to enter configuration page for custom appearance and shortcuts

footer.description: Supercharge your browsing experience with Blazwitcher.

guide.title: Try Pinyin initials in an open tab
guide.intro: For example, open a page titled “上下文工程” (context engineering). You can find it without switching to a Chinese keyboard.
guide.open: Open Blazwitcher with <mac></mac> on macOS or <windows></windows> on Windows if the default shortcut is assigned.
guide.search: Type <query></query>. The <filter></filter> prefix limits results to open tabs, and <initials></initials> matches the Pinyin initials of “上下文”.
guide.select: Use the arrow keys to select “上下文工程” and press <enter></enter> to switch to that tab.
guide.filters: Use <bookmarks></bookmarks> for bookmarks or <history></history> for browsing history. Select a saved result to open its page.

raycast.title: Prefer searching in Raycast?
raycast.description: Blazwitcher for Raycast is a separate extension for Google Chrome on macOS. It searches tabs, bookmarks, and history with Pinyin, but does not support Microsoft Edge or AI tab grouping. Basic search works without the optional Raycast Browser Extension.
raycast.install: Get Blazwitcher from the Raycast Store
